history.titleZh: Cognichip 揭示其新 AI 辅助程序如何将芯片
history.descriptionZh:
在AI热潮推动下，电子设计自动化（EDA）领域正出现越来越多AI辅助工作流，Cadence Maestro等工具是代表之一。Cognichip则进一步尝试用专门面向半导体工程的基础模型改造芯片前端设计流程。该公司于9月推出Artificial Chip Intelligence（ACI），称这是专为半导体工程开发的专有AI模型，并使用其所谓“业界最大训练数据集”覆盖半导体物理和芯片设计原理。其可部署平台ACI Enterprise将专用模型与代理式工作流、项目记忆和用于AI推理的计算基础设施结合起来。公司把ACI的方法描述为“自学习飞轮”：一个持续演进的设计环境，把规格、寄存器传输级（RTL）和验证结果结合起来，以在帕累托极限内满足功耗、性能和面积（PPA）目标。

Cognichip首席产品官Stelios Diamantidis在接受采访时表示，其数据集已超过1000万个训练样本，这些样本要么由公司直接设计，要么通过合成技术生成。公司称还发明了为半导体设计创建合成训练样本的新方法，并开发了新模型和新训练管线，以便捕获数据并将训练数据映射到模型。按照Cognichip的描述，ACI能够分析规格、探索微架构选项、生成RTL、验证设计、识别并修复功能问题，并优化设计以满足PPA目标；系统还可集成现有IP模块，甚至生成FPGA实现。其目标是让工程师聚焦产品需求和架构决策，而把大量逻辑实现和验证工作交给ACI。Diamantidis强调，系统是自验证的，不希望把设计师变成验证引擎，而是让设计师继续做设计，系统不仅完成任务，还验证任务结果。由于ACI以自学习飞轮方式运行，工程师可回到早先架构决策并修改设计，而不必从头重启整个开发流程。公司称架构、微架构和RTL等抽象在认知系统中是对齐的，微架构变化会自动反映到RTL，反之亦然。

Cognichip称已参与40多个客户合作项目，包括Renesas和SiTime的项目，覆盖微控制器、加密引擎、网络处理器、RISC-V CPU和AI加速器等多种芯片设计。为展示能力，公司提到与一家未具名领先无晶圆厂半导体公司的评估：客户提供一份55页的现有微架构规格，ACI据此探索架构选项、从零开发RTL、集成中间件等组件，生成SystemVerilog测试平台、运行仿真、识别并修正错误，并以超过90%的UVM覆盖率实现功能验证收敛。Cognichip称整个过程仅用10天、只需一名工程师；若用传统方法，同样工作需完整前端设计团队和约20周。不过文章也列出重要限定：客户已提供详细微架构规格，平台并非从白纸开始；Cognichip未披露设计复杂度，难以判断实际处理工作量；所称加速仅适用于前端工程，而非包括物理实现、流片、制造和硅验证的完整芯片开发流程。

ACI与完整芯片设计之间的关键差别在于，功能可用、经验证的RTL与可制造芯片设计不是一回事。尽管ACI可开发微架构、生成RTL并优化PPA，但不执行物理实现。布局规划、布局布线、时钟树综合、物理验证和签核仍需要Cadence、Synopsys和Siemens EDA等传统EDA工具。Diamantidis明确表示，目前不做物理实现，布局布线在系统之外完成。这一区分很重要，因为一个在估算中满足PPA目标的架构，在物理实现后可能达不到目标。例如设计预期以1 GHz运行、功耗15 W，但考虑互连延迟、时钟分布、缓冲需求、拥塞等物理效应后，可能只能达到800 MHz、20 W。此类偏差可能要求修改RTL甚至基本架构元素，然后再次验证和物理实现，某些情况下迭代会耗费数周或数月工程时间。Diamantidis称这种循环在时间上非常昂贵，因为跨越设计边界且运行时间很长。

Cognichip声称ACI可通过在物理实现前预测架构决策的物理后果来减少昂贵迭代。公司称其模型在内部开发和表征的半导体设计上训练，具有“完整物理栈可见性”，可在前端设计阶段预测PPA并识别潜在架构权衡。例如ACI可能建议把两个独立FIFO合并为一个时分复用FIFO，以牺牲性能换取功耗降低；Diamantidis用假设场景说明，若想省电而牺牲10%频率，可把两个不同任务的FIFO合并，让两个功能在一个FIFO上时分复用。公司称ACI不仅能估算此类变化的直接PPA后果，还能预测其对下游寄生、拥塞等物理实现影响的潜力，目标是在RTL进入物理设计团队之前解决潜在架构问题，而不是等实现结果出来再修改架构。Diamantidis表示，期望不会因为未达标或拥塞问题而把设计退回前端团队。

但预测准确性至关重要。Cognichip称其模型在物理实现预布线阶段对某些PPA特性的预测误差约为10%，相对传统EDA工具结果而言。公司用1200个开源设计评估技术，并与Anthropic Claude Opus和Google Gemini等通用AI模型比较；据称通用模型按指标不同误差约50%至100%，而Cognichip模型把预测误差降至约10%。Diamantidis称通用模型在预测延迟方面表现不佳。不过，这一准确度指的是预布线物理实现结果，而非最终布线后特性；实际布线会引入互连和供电寄生及其他物理效应，可能改变时序和功耗。因此10%误差不代表ACI生成的设计在物理实现和签核后一定能达到估算PPA目标。另一个问题是ACI在哪些架构和制造工艺上能保持这种准确度。Cognichip称模型纳入半导体物理并考虑工艺相关特性，但未披露支持哪些代工厂节点及不同节点下预测准确度如何变化。Diamantidis解释，芯片开发像一棵树，树冠顶部许多决策并非代工厂特定，更接近微架构；越往下越可能针对台积电节点A或节点B分支，产生不同预测结果；但大量主干决策与节点关系不大，更多与架构及实现方式有关。公司试图覆盖整棵树并向设计师提供大量反馈，尤其以节点无关模式，随后在某个阶段必须更具节点感知能力。这一区分对复杂CPU、GPU和AI加速器尤其重要，因为物理约束往往对架构决策影响很大。Cognichip并不声称ACI必须把这类处理器作为单体设计开发，而是称技术可处理单个IP块和子系统，工程师可随后集成到更大芯片中；当然，把这些分别优化的IP块集成进更大芯片仍是挑战。

Cognichip称ACI可处理包含数百万逻辑门的子系统，但把多个此类设计组合成复杂SoC会引入互连延迟、时钟分布、共享内存带宽、供电和布局规划等额外约束。因此，作为独立子系统实现帕累托最优PPA的架构，集成到更大芯片后可能不再最优。公司称ACI可通过按全局SoC和子系统约束对齐并优化单个模块来考虑这些系统级交互。Diamantidis表示，ACI可把单个模块与全局SoC和子系统约束对齐优化，适用于扁平化和层次化优化问题。Cognichip并非提出全新的SoC开发方法，而是自动化传统前端工作流中的很大一部分。ACI支持扁平化和层次化优化，可驱动设计约束从顶层向单个模块划分和传播；公司称ACI可把系统级约束分解为组件需求，并在模块集成时重新聚合。Diamantidis称ACI不要求扁平设计方法，可从顶层或子系统顶层驱动层次化设计，确保约束分解进入组件，并在模块集成时重新聚合。公司强调，决定ACI处理效果的是单个分区的复杂度而非规模；但ACI在实践中能否有效协调整个复杂SoC的架构决策并优化PPA仍有待观察。毕竟，一个帕累托最优的CPU核心、内存控制器和互连不一定组成帕累托最优SoC，因为它们之间的交互会引入额外时序、带宽、功耗和物理约束。不过，复杂SoC开发者本来就通过层次化设计方法、系统级优化和集成应对这些挑战，因此ACI聚焦单个子系统未必是重大局限。

关于前端工具如何处理物理实现反馈循环，Cognichip称ACI可在必要时利用物理实现结果修改RTL和微架构，但这不是主要焦点。公司更希望在前端预测潜在问题，避免前后端团队之间昂贵迭代。Diamantidis称公司仍非常聚焦前端能做什么来预防这些情况，而不是修复它们。如果物理实现暴露需要修改RTL或微架构的问题，工程师可带着相关反馈回到ACI环境，公司未说明反馈必须以何种文件格式提交，然后基于信息调整设计；但ACI不能解决需要改变物理实现本身的问题，如时钟树综合或布局布线。Diamantidis称客户可回到其环境提供额外指导、提示和信息，基于这些信息可对设计进行适配；如果问题能在设计本身解决，当然可以做。文章作者询问ACI能否摄取Cadence、Synopsys或Siemens EDA工具的物理实现报告，识别架构瓶颈、修改微架构和RTL并重复直到满足PPA目标。Diamantidis回答称这正是其偏离传统方法之处：不需要等到物理实现才识别问题，模型具有完整物理栈可见性，可在前端预测PPA。例如一个设计以某频率运行并消耗一定功耗，另一个可能慢20%但功耗显著更低，可在物理实现前识别这些权衡。最终要做的改变涉及RTL和设计约束。传统上工程师开发RTL和约束交给物理实现团队，团队实现并报告结果；若未达标，前端团队修改，流程重新开始。这些迭代时间成本很高，因为跨设计边界且工具运行时间长。通过在全物理栈上训练模型，可在前端立即反馈，例如告诉工程师若想省电而牺牲10%频率，可把两个不同功能FIFO合并并时分复用。这只是微架构决策的一个例子。公司模型可预测对下游寄生、布线拥塞等物理特性的影响，使工程师在前端开发中以闭环方式做决策。解决微架构权衡并生成结构良好的RTL后，再交给物理实现团队；设计仍须经过物理实现工具。公司期望不会因为未达标或拥塞问题而把设计退回前端，这是其希望在前端和后端芯片开发衔接处带来的根本变化。

对于第三方IP，现代SoC通常把专有逻辑与处理器核心、内存控制器、接口IP等第三方IP结合，但开发者未必能访问授权IP块的RTL，许可协议也可能限制信息使用。Cognichip称这不是问题：ACI不需要检查专有RTL即可把现有IP块集成到更大设计。此类IP提供相关接口规格，包括引脚连接、信号及其特性，ACI可据此推进必要集成逻辑并把IP连接到其他子系统。Diamantidis称多数人想拿第三方授权IP并优化IP集成，但公司本身不摄取IP内部，也不尝试训练任何与IP相关的数据。他强调ACI Enterprise在公司防火墙数据中心内保护客户IP，防止其进入第三方AI训练管线；平台提供客户控制的敏感信息访问、多租户隔离和通过SOC 2 Type II审查验证的安全控制。不过这些保护不能取代第三方IP提供方施加的许可限制。

总体来看，Cognichip的ACI技术有望通过自动化架构探索、RTL开发、验证和PPA优化等劳动密集型任务，显著提高芯片开发生产力。公司与一家大型芯片设计商的基准测试暗示潜在收益可观，但项目复杂度未披露。此类能力对半导体初创公司和行业新进入者尤其有价值，因为他们往往缺乏成熟芯片公司的工程资源和广泛IP组合。通过降低定制硅开发所需时间、成本和专业知识，ACI可能降低进入门槛，使较小公司能够推行原本过于昂贵的定制硅战略。然而，Cognichip尚未展示自主开发完整且经过物理验证的芯片，更不用说复杂CPU或GPU。公司不执行物理实现，其消除昂贵反馈循环的期望取决于PPA预测准确性。ACI能否在共同功耗、性能和面积约束下有效优化结合众多专有和第三方IP块的复杂SoC，也仍有待观察。最终，对领先芯片开发者而言，Cognichip技术的价值不仅取决于多快生成经验证的RTL，还取决于其预测与物理实现结果的匹配程度，以及能在整个开发周期中消除多少工程工作。

history.title: Congress could issue subpoena to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if he doesn’t respond by today to request for a ‘joint, closed-door briefing’
history.description: Three committee chairpersons want to grill Jensen Huang about his company's 'security protocols against foreign adversary espionage,' as a former CIA agent says that he had a target on his back as the leader of a trillion-dollar company.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 11 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Rep. Brian Mast (R-Fla.), the chairperson of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, has said that he will issue a subpoena to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang if he does not respond to the committee’s request to meet with them on November 18 by Wednesday, November 11, according to ABC News. The House invited him to a “joint, closed-door briefing” with the heads of the House committees on China, Foreign Affairs, and Intelligence, and that they will focus on his company’s “security protocols against foreign adversary espionage.”Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc)While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply marketThe state of China's decade-long semiconductor pushHuawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fabChina's latest round of rare-earth export controls explainedCongress first called the embattled CEO on November 7, a few days after rumors started circulating about Huang’s “closeness” to a particular Chinese executive suspected of passing information to Chinese intelligence. The following day, Nvidia released a statement from Jensen admitting to an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, apologizing for his unfaithfulness, while the company’s board of directors confirmed it will launch an independent investigation regarding the allegations that the CEO has been specifically targeted by China’s Ministry of State Security (MSS). Aside from having to face Congress, Jensen Huang is also reportedly being looked into by the FBI.It remains unclear whether Jensen Huang was targeted by intelligence agencies, but he came into prominence with the AI boom that was arguably fueled by Nvidia’s AI chips. This led to the AI race as we know it today, with the U.S. taking steps to delay China’s advancement for fears that it will use the technology for military purposes. We also don’t know if Huang Le or Alice Huang is actually a Chinese spy or an “innocent” bystander caught in a web of accusations. And, even if she did work with the MSS, the question remains as to whether she specifically targeted the Nvidia CEO or whether Chinese intelligence discovered their indiscretion and used that as a convenient tool for blackmail to extract information from her.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: However, former CIA agent Darrel Blocker told ABC News that the authorities should just focus on Jensen. “I think that the biggest concern is that the focus or overfocus on just Jensen Huang and Nvidia risks losing sight of the fact that other people have been targeted by the Chinese. Are they talking to the engineers? Are they talking to other people who might have even more access than even the CEO has? So, this focus should not be singular; it should include everyone in the company, and quite frankly, every tech company out there should be looking at all the contacts that their officers and employees have.”“It’s definitely not a one-time thing. When you run a trillion-dollar company, you know that you have a bullseye on your back; whether it’s from competition or rather from nation-states, so this is absolutely not a one-off. Jensen Huang is not the only person at Nvidia that has access to the crown jewels, so I would be looking at the other people in terms of the access that they enjoy and their proximity to Chinese nationals.” You may like Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to Congress over affair with alleged Chinese spy Nvidia's Jensen Huang officially called to Congress due to reports of a Chinese spy plot US intelligence believes Jensen Huang had affair with Chinese spy in honeypot operation Follow Tom's Hardware on Google News, or add us as a preferred source, to get our latest news, analysis, & reviews in your feeds.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors

history.titleZh: 若英伟达CEO黄仁勋今日前不回应“联合闭门简报”请求，国会或向其发出传票
history.descriptionZh:
美国众议院外交事务委员会主席、佛罗里达州共和党众议员布莱恩·马斯特表示，如果英伟达CEO黄仁勋不在11月11日（周三）前回应委员会提出的11月18日会面请求，他将向黄仁勋发出传票。据ABC News报道，众议院邀请黄仁勋与负责中国、外交事务和情报事务的多个委员会负责人举行“联合闭门简报”，重点讨论英伟达“防范外国对手间谍活动的安全协议”。

事件背景是，国会最初于11月7日联系黄仁勋，而此前几天出现传闻称，黄仁勋与一名疑似向中国情报机构传递信息的中国高管关系密切。次日，英伟达发布黄仁勋声明，承认与Megaspeed高管Alice Huang存在婚外情，并为不忠道歉；公司董事会确认将就“CEO被中国国家安全部（MSS）针对性针对”的指控启动独立调查。另有报道称，黄仁勋还正被FBI调查。

报道同时强调多项关键事实仍不确定：目前不清楚黄仁勋是否确实被情报机构针对；也不清楚Alice Huang究竟是间谍，还是被卷入指控的“无辜”旁观者；即便她与中国国安部有关，她是否专门针对英伟达CEO，还是中国情报机构发现其不当关系后借机敲诈获取信息，仍无定论。前CIA特工达雷尔·布洛克对ABC News表示，当局不应只盯着黄仁勋，因为“英伟达并非只有CEO能接触核心机密”，其他工程师和员工也可能成为目标；他建议调查应覆盖公司内所有可能接触敏感信息的人，并称所有科技公司都应审查高管和员工与中方人员的接触。

文章还链接了美国对华芯片制裁反复、中国推进自主芯片供应链、华为昇腾NPU路线图、长鑫存储目标2030年占据30% DRAM市场份额以及中国稀土出口管制等背景报道。整体来看，这一事件发生在AI芯片推动全球AI竞赛、美国担忧中国将相关技术用于军事目的并限制对华技术出口的背景下，凸显AI芯片龙头企业在美中科技竞争中所面临的安全、合规与政治风险。原文未涉及具体芯片性能参数或技术对比数据。

history.title: Cyanogen co-founder unveils Kora, a Linux OS that splits AI models across the CPU, GPU, and NPU
history.description: Kora, a Linux desktop OS with built-in AI models and agents for local agentic work, is coming to PCs in 2027, including Snapdragon X2 Elite machines.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter A team led by Cyanogen co-founder Kirt McMaster has unveiled Kora, a new Linux desktop OS with integrated AI models and agents that can split workloads across CPU, GPU, and NPU resources, as well as other machines on the same local network. We reached out to the firm for more info.Kora, the first product from Kora Systems Inc., previously Playtron, carries the tagline “The Operating System for Intelligence” and has its own Cortex “hybrid inference engine” technology, which is not open source and is optimized for local models. The OS, built “from the kernel to the shell,” runs local models by default and cloud models when needed, and is expected to arrive on PCs in 2027.The desktop follows the AI-focused motif with “neural workspaces” and a “neural file system,” which refer to sandboxed workspaces and files indexed by semantic meaning. Kora has three operating modes: “Work," "Create," and "Play." That last base is covered by GameFrame, which descends from Playtron’s GameOS. Humain OS, which Kora is developing with Saudi AI company Humain, is the enterprise variant of this OS.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Currently, the only NPU named in the release material is the Hexagon NPU found in the Snapdragon X2 Elite, which Qualcomm pegs at 80 TOPS. On the X2 Elite, Cortex can schedule AI workloads across the CPU, GPU, and NPU, as well as other systems on the local network, which could be a novel capability if it works beyond the Qualcomm hardware.McMaster told Tom’s Hardware that the Snapdragon X2 Elite NPU runs Google's Gemma 4 26B model at 25 tokens per second for decode. Intel and AMD NPU support is in the works, but according to the developer, neither NPU will be used for LLMs, as GPUs are “just better for LLM workloads on x64.” You may like Open source project renders your Windows 11 desktop using the NPU rather than the GPU Old MacBook uses a mirror, webcam, and AI agent to code its own AMD GPU drivers Stripped-down Windows 11 for AI developers demands 64GB RAM and insane 250 GB/s bandwidth Each NPU vendor has its own software stack, or runtime, and prefers that models are compiled in its own format: Qualcomm with QAIRT/QNN, Intel with OpenVINO, and AMD with Ryzen AI software. The press kit doesn't identify support for any Intel or AMD chip, NPU runtime, model format, quantization, or speed figures for those platforms.Our earlier Windows testing showed the same kind of divide: Snapdragon reached its NPU through the QNN provider under ONNX Runtime, while Intel’s work ran through IPEX, its extension for PyTorch, on the GPU because it was faster than the NPU.Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware NewsletterGet Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.Contact me with news and offers from other Future brandsReceive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsorsWhen asked about cross-vendor support, McMaster reiterated that “only Hexagon on Snapdragon X2 Elite is supported today.” Intel NPU support is planned, with “conversations underway,” though McMaster later clarified that neither Intel’s nor AMD’s NPU will be used for LLMs. On AMD’s Ryzen AI chips, Kora will likely use the NPU for embedding and speech-recognition models through ONNX.As for what drives the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU, McMaster said Kora uses the “llama.cpp Hexagon backend” and “the upstream FastRPC driver.” That suggests the operating system reaches the NPU through the open-source llama.cpp project, not Qualcomm’s own QAIRT/QNN runtime, by way of the FastRPC driver in the mainline kernel. Swipe to scroll horizontally Kora NPU support by vendor, per the company NPU Vendor’s own framework Status in Kora Runtime KORA uses What it runs Qualcomm Hexagon (Snapdragon X2 Elite) QAIRT/QNN Supported today llama.cpp’s Hexagon backend Language models; KORA cites Gemma 4 26B at 25 tokens per second AMD XDNA 2 (Ryzen AI) Ryzen AI software Planned for launch ONNX Likely embedding and speech-recognition models; not language models Intel NPUs OpenVINO Planned, “conversations underway” Not stated Not language models When asked about model formats, McMaster said, “we predominantly support GGUF,” llama.cpp’s model file format, and that Lemma, the inference engine inside Cortex, “can split model layers across processors as needed.” Lemma is built on llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, stable-diffusion.cpp, and ONNX. McMaster says that which runtime is used depends on the model's requirements, and more runtimes will be added down the line.For today, llama.cpp has a Hexagon backend for Snapdragon and an OpenVINO backend for Intel CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, although the latter is still marked “In Progress,” and no AMD NPU backend, which would explain why AMD goes through ONNX. AMD NPUs can run LLMs on Linux through the separate Lemonade 10.0 stack with FastFlowLM, as reported by Phoronix in March, though that isn’t the route Kora has chosen. What to read next AI model gets a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled directly into its weights, then runs DOOM on it Geekbench 7 results suggest OpenAI's dots run on nine-core AMD EPYC VMs Minisforum launches local AI solutions at IFA 2026 Beyond NPU stacks, those hoping to run Kora will need to be mindful of their system's available memory. The Gemma 4 26B model Kora uses, which Google lists as Gemma 4 26B A4B, needs about 14.4GB of memory to load its weights at 4-bit (Q4_0) quantization, by Google’s estimate, before any context window, while third-party listings put the download for the Q4_K_M file Kora uses at about 16–17GB. The model only activates about 4 billion of its 26 billion parameters per token but still needs to be fully loaded into memory.McMaster said that with the model, the X2 Elite reaches “25 TPS decode throughput and 550 TPS prefill throughput,” or tokens per second, running “entirely on the Hexagon NPU with 32K context.” A dense model, rather than a mixture-of-experts, would be far slower. Not given are the RAM configuration or the specific X2 Elite chip.On memory, McMaster said that “we recommend 64GB because it gives you access to better models,” but that is not a firm requirement. The company projects that “about 70 percent of the model calls it manages will run locally in 2027.”Kora says its enterprise-focused Humain OS is due first and will be “commercially available in 2027,” on OEM PCs using the Snapdragon X2 Elite. Kora will follow "later in 2027.”McMaster says that “Kora will be posted on our site and downloadable for anyone to install.” Included will be a list of recommended configurations, “but it should be installable on most modern PCs.” Exact pricing and the overall business model will be shared closer to the date of availability.Edit: 11/11/2026 9:06am PT: Added further follow-up details provided by the maker. history.titleZh: Cyanogen 联合创始人推出 Kora：一款
history.descriptionZh:
Cyanogen联合创始人Kirt McMaster领导的团队发布了Kora，这是一款面向AI时代的Linux桌面操作系统，由Kora Systems Inc.（前身为Playtron）推出，口号是“The Operating System for Intelligence”。Kora从内核到桌面shell完整构建，默认在本地运行AI模型，在需要时调用云端模型，并集成AI模型与智能体。其核心是自研、非开源的Cortex“混合推理引擎”，针对本地模型优化。Kora计划于2027年登陆PC，企业版本Humain OS则与沙特AI公司Humain合作开发。

Kora围绕AI重构桌面体验，提供“神经工作区”和“神经文件系统”，前者指沙箱化工作区，后者指按语义索引文件。系统有三种模式：工作、创作和游戏；游戏能力由GameFrame支持，技术源自Playtron的GameOS。企业版Humain OS将率先商业化。

技术实现上，Cortex内部的Lemma推理引擎基于llama.cpp、whisper.cpp、stable-diffusion.cpp和ONNX，主要支持GGUF模型格式，并能按需把模型层拆分到不同处理器上运行；具体使用哪种运行时取决于模型需求，未来还会增加更多运行时。Kora可在CPU、GPU、NPU以及同一局域网内的其他机器之间调度AI负载。目前发布材料中明确支持的NPU只有高通骁龙X2 Elite中的Hexagon NPU，Qualcomm给出的算力为80 TOPS。Kora通过llama.cpp的Hexagon后端和上游FastRPC驱动访问该NPU，而不是高通的QAIRT/QNN运行时。Intel NPU支持仍在推进中，官方称“对话正在进行”；AMD Ryzen AI的XDNA 2 NPU计划在发布时支持。但McMaster明确表示，Intel和AMD的NPU都不会用于大语言模型，因为在x64平台上GPU对LLM负载更合适；AMD NPU预计通过ONNX承担嵌入和语音识别等模型。

性能方面，Kora给出的数据显示，在骁龙X2 Elite上，Google Gemma 4 26B模型可完全运行在Hexagon NPU上，32K上下文下实现25 tokens/s的解码吞吐和550 tokens/s的预填充吞吐。该模型为Gemma 4 26B A4B，属于混合专家模型，总参数26B，但每个token仅激活约4B参数，仍需完整加载到内存。按Google估算，4位Q4_0量化下仅权重就需约14.4GB内存，尚未计入上下文窗口；第三方资料显示Kora使用的Q4_K_M文件下载大小约16–17GB。Kora建议64GB内存以便运行更好的模型，但这不是硬性要求。公司预计2027年其管理的模型调用中约70%将在本地运行。

这一方案的意义在于推动“本地优先”的AI PC体验：降低云端依赖、提升隐私和离线可用性，并通过NPU、GPU、CPU及局域网设备协同扩展本地推理能力。不过，它也面临NPU厂商运行时和模型格式碎片化、跨平台支持有限、内存需求高等挑战。发布计划上，面向企业的Humain OS将率先在2027年通过采用骁龙X2 Elite的OEM PC商业化上市，Kora随后于2027年晚些时候推出，并可在官网下载安装，官方将提供推荐配置列表，称其应可安装在大多数现代PC上；具体定价和商业模式将在临近上市时公布。

history.title: AMD shares how it can retain 95% of server performance with just half the DRAM, sidestepping memory shortages with MEXT
history.description: Following AMD’s acquisition of MEXT earlier this year, the company has revealed its own IT infrastructure is using the technology to run servers at 50% DRAM capacity while achieving 95% of the performance of a full-DRAM system in certain applications.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter In June, AMD overtook the predictive memory engine known as MEXT, which claims to offer upwards of 99% of the performance of a system with full DRAM capacity while running with as little as 25% of the physical DIMMs. The technology offloads cold memory pages to flash storage and uses an AI model to serve pages before they’re needed, and AMD says it plans to extend the tech across a wide swath of its IT infrastructure next year.The pitch behind MEXT seems too good to be true. According to AMD and MEXT founder Gary Smerdon, the technology can cut the physical DRAM required in a server by 20% to 75% depending on the application and performance target. That missing memory still registers as installed DRAM to the OS. Instead of DRAM, however, MEXT uses relatively inexpensive flash storage to offload cold pages, flying them back in as they’re needed with an AI model. In some of AMD’s internal workloads, such as Synopsys PrimeTime, the company says it’s able to achieve 95% of the performance of a full server while running at 50% DRAM capacity with MEXT.AMD has deployed MEXT internally on 145 servers, which it says will expand to 2,000 servers next year. In addition, the company has announced a partnership with HPE to bring MEXT to customers. Currently, we’re in phase 1 of the rollout, with some EPYC Venice servers carrying a “MEXT Ready” badge and a dedicated NVMe drive or bay for the offload. Phase 2 brings MEXT licenses out to these servers, as well as the RAM View application. AMD hasn’t said when Phase 2 will begin.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The AI-driven DRAM pricing surge impacts more than just gaming PCs, with enterprises also feeling the brunt of price increases, even if they aren’t running AI workloads. If MEXT is able to achieve what AMD claims, it could be transformative given the current market. Because of that, it’s worth understanding what exactly MEXT is, as well as what AMD claims it can do.Although MEXT is exciting in concept, it’s obvious that AMD is taking a conservative approach to the rollout. Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence, after all. The applications of MEXT are currently narrow, though AMD says it’s expanding the workloads it’s using MEXT on with promising early results. You may like Marvell VP pushes for DDR4 recycling for use in CXL memory, amid the worst DRAM shortage in years — company introduces three-tier AI memory infrastructure Micron announces 512GB DDR5-9200 memory modules with 16W power draw AMD debuts Helion reference design for agentic AI servers with up to 32,768 Zen 6 ‘Venice’ cores DRAM, Flash and an LLM (Image credit: AMD)The basic setup of MEXT is simple in concept: cold pages go to flash, AI brings those pages back as needed, and it’s as if the memory was never missing in the first place. The main problem should be obvious. Flash is orders of magnitude slower than DRAM, so streaming pages back into memory from flash as they’re needed isn’t feasible. MEXT’s trick is using an AI model to predict the pages you’ll need. And, as long as the model is able to stay ahead by at least the transfer latency from the SSD, it’s as if the physical DRAM was installed the whole time.This isn’t a crazy concept considering how a transformer-based LLM, which MEXT uses, operates. If you’re unfamiliar with the inner workings, this open-source visualization breaks down the concept of a transformer AI model cleanly. The foundational concept is next token prediction, which underpins the design of modern LLMs. Given a set of tokens, the LLM determines which token (word, portion of a word, etc.) is most likely to come next. It makes a prediction. In the case of MEXT, it’s predicting what page is needed next, not what word comes next. (Image credit: AMD)Memory offloading to flash isn’t a new concept, but MEXT founder Gary Smerdon says that AI is the critical difference in this technology. MEXT itself is deployed as a Linux kernel module that works with any Linux distro. It uses an “ensemble of AI models,” with the primary transformer-based LLM driving the technology. And critically, it doesn’t come pre-trained.Instead, AMD says that MEXT trains in under a second when first deployed, operates on one EPYC core without a GPU, and continually trains as the workload progresses. This approach makes sense given the varied workloads that MEXT may apply to. The idea is that it would learn the access patterns of the application in order to drive that prediction engine.MEXT isn’t perfect, but it doesn’t need to be perfect in every situation. For instance, the order of stored pages isn’t important. With text, an LLM needs to predict the correct text in the correct order, but with MEXT, the order doesn’t matter. As long as the page is in DRAM when it’s needed, that’s fine. What to read next AMD Zen 6 EPYC ‘Venice’ deep dive and benchmarking Micron details ambitious DRAM and NAND roadmap — 3D NAND, High-NA EUV, new materials, and custom silicon makes a comeback CXMT president says company’s first 4F² DRAM will be a server DDR5 RDIMM due by year-end In order to understand the application of MEXT to different workloads, AMD has developed RAM View to go alongside the tech. It’s a memory utilization tool that shows which pages are hot and which have gone cold. As you can see from the example above, a system with 1.5 TB of memory shows near-full utilization across the full workload, but around half of the pages stored in memory haven’t been touched in five minutes or more at any given time.AMD provided this generalized example and didn’t clarify what workload it was testing. That’s very important, as the utilization breakdown will look vastly different depending on the application(s) running on the server. Initially, AMD is applying MEXT to critical EDA applications it uses internally, such as Synopsys PrimeTime, but the company says it has focused on optimizing agentic AI, database, and media and entertainment workloads as well. (Image credit: AMD)This is important not only because memory access patterns change between applications, but also because performance in those applications reacts differently when a system doesn’t have enough memory. The “memory wall,” as AMD calls it, should be a familiar concept regardless of whether you’ve ever touched a server. With MEXT, AMD says it’s trying to extend this memory wall, which may look different for different applications.For instance, the company is confident that many workloads can reduce capacity by around 20% to 25%. As the reduction increases, however, the applications become more specialized, and the performance delta becomes greater.AMD’s internal MEXT results (Image credit: AMD)AMD has shared some internal MEXT results, which look impressive, though as usual, it’s always smart to handle first-party benchmarks like this with skepticism. Starting with PrimeTime, where AMD has focused much of its attention on MEXT up to this point, it says servers running at 50% capacity retain 95% of the performance of a full server, and going down to as little as 25% capacity still maintains 80% of the application’s performance. (Image credit: AMD)PrimeTime demands a lot of memory for large designs. There are some applications where performance is nearly identical, according to AMD. In a 3-node cluster running in Azure with 5th-gen EPYC CPUs, AMD says MEXT offers 99% of the performance of the full cluster while running at 50% DRAM capacity with the Spark SQL workload from the TPC-DS benchmark. SQL databases try to cache as much data as possible in memory to prevent I/O bottlenecks, creating a golden opportunity for tech like MEXT that wants to free cold pages. (Image credit: AMD)Perhaps the most applicable workload at the current moment, however, is agentic AI, and AMD says MEXT has similar applications there. Across a five-agent concurrent geomean, AMD claims 99% of the performance of a full server with 50% memory capacity, and 85% of the performance with 25% capacity. With a “memory-hungry” agent, AMD claims 90% and 88% performance for 50% and 25% capacity, respectively.The slide you can see above has footnote tags. However, AMD has not shared the footnotes with us yet, so we don’t have a view into how these tests were run. Naturally, we assume AMD has, at minimum, represented the performance of MEXT in the best light possible. We can’t do a full analysis without knowing how the tests were run, however.What is interesting is AMD’s cautious approach to rolling out MEXT. It’s an EPYC-exclusive feature right now, though AMD left the door open for support on future products (consumer devices, such as Strix Halo) far down the road. It will be sold as a license, bundled with the RAM View software, but we don’t have a timeline on when that will happen. And, despite a partnership with HPE to push out “MEXT Ready” servers, we still don’t know when MEXT itself will be ready for deployment beyond AMD’s walls.Given that conservative approach, there are likely pitfalls to MEXT that we’re not seeing yet, and it’s hard to imagine it will be broadly applicable to every server, at least at the 50% and 25% DRAM capacity levels that AMD showed off with its benchmarks.However, even being able to trim 25% of a server’s DRAM capacity represents a massive cost savings in the current supply-constrained environment. If some workloads can push that to 50% capacity, that’s even better. Of course, we’ll need to see how MEXT holds up once it’s available broadly, but if AMD’s claims hold water, it could become a defining technology in data centers that can’t seem to get enough memory.

history.titleZh: AMD分享如何仅用一半DRAM保持95%服务器性能，借助MEXT规避内存短缺
history.descriptionZh:
AMD已接手名为MEXT的预测式内存引擎技术。MEXT宣称，在仅配置相当于完整DRAM容量25%的物理DIMM时，仍可提供完整DRAM系统99%以上的性能。其核心思路是把“冷”内存页卸载到相对廉价的闪存中，并利用AI模型预测页面需求、提前取回，从而让操作系统仍将缺失的容量视为已安装DRAM。AMD计划明年将这项技术扩展到更广泛的IT基础设施中。

背景上，AI驱动的DRAM价格和供应压力正在影响企业级市场，即使不运行AI负载的企业也受到内存涨价波及。若MEXT能够兑现承诺，在当前供应受限环境下可能具有变革意义。根据AMD和MEXT创始人Gary Smerdon的说法，MEXT可根据应用和性能目标将服务器所需物理DRAM减少20%至75%。在AMD内部部分工作负载中，例如Synopsys PrimeTime，MEXT在50%DRAM容量下可达到完整服务器95%的性能。AMD已在145台服务器内部部署MEXT，并计划明年扩大到2000台；同时宣布与HPE合作，将MEXT推向客户。目前处于推广第一阶段：部分EPYC Venice服务器带有“MEXT Ready”标识，并配备用于卸载的专用NVMe驱动器或插槽。第二阶段将向这些服务器提供MEXT许可证以及RAM View应用，但AMD尚未公布第二阶段时间表。

技术原理上，MEXT的基本流程是：冷页面写入闪存，AI在需要时将这些页面带回，使系统表现得像内存从未缺失。难点在于闪存比DRAM慢几个数量级，按需从闪存流式取回页面通常不可行。MEXT的关键是用AI模型预测将要访问的页面；只要模型预测能比SSD传输延迟提前足够时间，效果就近似于物理DRAM一直存在。MEXT使用基于Transformer的大语言模型，其底层概念与LLM的“下一token预测”类似，只不过MEXT预测的是“下一页”而不是“下一个词”。内存卸载到闪存并非全新概念，但MEXT认为AI是决定性差异。MEXT以Linux内核模块形式部署，可配合任何Linux发行版使用，采用“AI模型集成”，由主Transformer LLM驱动。它不需要预训练：首次部署时在一秒内完成训练，仅占用一个EPYC核心且无需GPU，并随工作负载持续训练，以学习应用的访问模式。

MEXT并不追求在所有场景下完美，也不需要完美。例如，页面存储顺序并不重要，只要所需页面在需要时位于DRAM即可。为帮助理解不同工作负载的适用性，AMD开发了RAM View内存利用工具，可显示哪些页面是热页、哪些已变冷。AMD给出的示例中，一台1.5TB内存系统在整个工作负载下接近满利用率，但任意时刻约有一半内存页面已至少五分钟未被访问；不过AMD未说明该示例的具体工作负载，因此实际冷热分布会因应用而异。AMD最初将MEXT用于内部关键EDA应用，如Synopsys PrimeTime，同时也在优化代理式AI、数据库、媒体和娱乐等负载。

性能数据方面，AMD公布的首方结果看起来亮眼，但测试细节和脚注尚未完整披露，仍需谨慎看待。PrimeTime在50%容量下保留95%性能，在25%容量下仍保留80%性能。在一个Azure三节点集群、第五代EPYC CPU、TPC-DS基准的Spark SQL工作负载中，AMD称MEXT在50%DRAM容量下可达到完整集群99%的性能。代理式AI方面，在五个代理并发的几何平均值下，50%内存容量可达到完整服务器99%的性能，25%容量可达到85%；对于“内存饥渴型”代理，50%和25%容量分别可达到90%和88%的性能。SQL数据库通常会尽量缓存数据以避免I/O瓶颈，这为MEXT释放冷页面提供了机会。

影响和应用场景上，MEXT当前主要面向EPYC服务器，属于较窄的初期应用，但AMD称正在扩展工作负载并取得有希望的早期结果。AMD将MEXT视为延伸“内存墙”的手段：许多工作负载可减少约20%至25%的容量，而减少幅度越大，应用越专用、性能差距也越明显。当前MEXT是EPYC独占功能，AMD未排除未来支持消费级产品（如Strix Halo）的可能，但称那还很遥远。MEXT将以许可证形式销售并捆绑RAM View，但上市时间未定；尽管有HPE合作推出“MEXT Ready”服务器，MEXT本身何时能在AMD之外广泛部署仍不清楚。AMD的保守推进表明该技术可能仍有未显现的陷阱，也难以想象它能适用于所有服务器，尤其是在50%和25%DRAM容量这样的激进水平上。不过，在当前内存供应紧张的环境下，哪怕只削减25%的DRAM容量也意味着显著成本节省；若部分工作负载能推进到50%，收益更大。最终仍需在MEXT广泛可用后验证AMD的说法，但如果这些性能主张成立，它可能成为内存不足的数据中心中的一项关键定义性技术。

history.title: Elon Musk wants to build a s $24 billion gas-powered AI supercomputer in Texas company town
history.description: The city of Starbase, Texas, is set to vote on a proposed $24 billion data center to be built within its limits, but the SpaceX company town may not provide the friendly regulatory environment that owner Elon Musk might have hoped for.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Starbase, Texas, which hosts SpaceX’s Starship rocket program, has just posted a notice of a public hearing for a gas-fired power plant and supercomputing facility within the corporate limits of the city. The project has an initial cost of $24 billion and will apparently be owned by SpaceX. Bloomberg reports that the project could face resistance from incoming Texas governor Gina Hinojosa, who campaigned against approving new data centers until the state's legislature has enacted stronger protections against potential harms from those projects.Until now, Elon Musk's SpaceXSI has been building out its Colossus I and Colossus II data centers near the Mississippi-Tennessee border, but those projects have faced backlash, attracting a lawsuit from area residents that aims to curb the pollutants produced by the large number of gas turbines required to power those facilities.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleNow, it seems that SpaceXSI wants to build another site in Texas that would lie in a city that mostly sits on land owned by SpaceX and whose population mostly comprises its own employees. The project might face reduced local opposition compared to the company's Memphis facilities, as Starbase is essentially a company town for SpaceX. But Hinojosa's arrival in the governor's office could trump that seemingly permissible local regulatory climate.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: The project would seem to be a part of SpaceX’s push to build 10 gigawatts of compute in 2027 alone, and the $24 billion budget for this new facility could make it one of the biggest and most expensive data center projects focused on a single site. The company's announcement also notes that the $24 billion outlay it foresees was only for the “initial phases of the projects” and that it could “include future expansions.” That suggests that SpaceXSI could invest in more capacity in Starbase, Texas, going forward, assuming the favorable regulatory climate the company likely hoped for in the area holds.Beyond its new terrestrial ambitions in Starbase, SpaceX also remains hard at work on launching data centers into space. Musk has already laid out the plans for a first-generation AI1 compute satellite with a 150kW peak compute payload, and submitted a proposal to build a 1-million-satellite Orbital Data Center System to the FCC. That work could accelerate after data center measures lost big in the poll in the recent U.S. midterm elections. history.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克想在得克萨斯州的公司镇建造一台价值240亿美元、由天然气驱动的人工智能超级计算机
history.descriptionZh:
Tom's Hardware报道称，位于得克萨斯州的Starbase市已就市界内建设一座燃气发电厂和超级计算设施发布公开听证通知。Starbase是SpaceX“星舰”火箭项目所在地，该项目初始成本为240亿美元，且显然将由SpaceX拥有。背景是，SpaceX此前在密西西比州与田纳西州边界附近建设Colossus I和Colossus II数据中心，因大量燃气轮机供电带来的污染物问题遭到当地居民反对并引发诉讼。Starbase实质上接近SpaceX的“公司镇”：城市大部分土地由SpaceX拥有，人口也主要是公司员工，因此当地反对声可能小于孟菲斯附近项目；但即将上任的得州州长Gina Hinojosa曾主张，在州议会通过更强保护措施以应对数据中心潜在危害之前，不应批准新的数据中心，这可能成为项目阻力。

从技术路径看，该项目把燃气发电与AI超级计算/数据中心设施捆绑，以现场发电满足大规模GPU集群的电力需求。燃气轮机既是供电核心，也是排放和诉讼焦点；SpaceX已开始自制涡轮叶片，以提高燃气发电机输出，体现其在能源设备上的垂直整合。该项目被视为SpaceX“2027年建成10吉瓦算力”计划的一部分，240亿美元仅覆盖“初始阶段”，未来还可能扩建，因而可能成为全球最大、最昂贵的单点数据中心项目之一。相关报道还称，SpaceX的AI业务（文中写作SpaceXAI/SpaceXSI）今年将新增66万块AI GPU，总运营量接近144万块；分析师认为，其在1.5年内建成超过谷歌整个生命周期容量的数据中心算力是可能的。这些参数显示其算力扩张速度和规模远超传统云厂商节奏。

影响层面，地面项目仍面临电力供给、环保审批、选址和社区诉讼等风险。与此同时，SpaceX也在推进太空数据中心：马斯克已公布首代AI1算力卫星，单星峰值算力载荷为150千瓦，并向美国联邦通信委员会提交了由100万颗卫星组成的轨道数据中心系统提案。美国中期选举中数据中心相关措施受挫后，马斯克在X上称“太空数据中心现在看起来很有吸引力”。太空方案可绕开部分地面土地、电力和环保审批瓶颈，但受发射成本、轨道供电与散热、通信带宽、维护及空间监管制约。若相关计划落地，将服务于AI训练和推理等大规模算力需求，并可能改变数据中心的选址、供能和部署模式。

history.title: Ukrainian drone operations squeezed by fiber optic cable shortage triggered by AI data center buildouts
history.description: Ukrainian drone manufacturer BlueBird Tech says that limited fiber optic supplies are making it harder to build jam-proof fiber optic drones.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine sparked a new era of drone warfare. Russian invaders first used drones with fiber-optic tethers to combat electronic warfare on the front lines, but both sides now use these jam-proof drones. Against that backdrop, the AI data center buildout is making it harder for Ukraine to buy the fiber-optic spools that it needs to continue scaling its drone manufacturing capabilities. A research and development representative for BlueBird Tech, a Ukrainian defense firm specializing in drones, told Ars Technica in an interview that prices of fiber optic cables have risen around six to 10 times in the past couple of years as AI data center demand soaks up more and more of the supply of this resource.According to that interview, It’s estimated that Ukraine and Russia are producing around 50,000 fiber optic drones monthly, with each drone capable of ranges of up to 62 miles. But Ukraine has only been able to acquire 72 miles of fiber optic cable from Chinese suppliers during August 2025, whereas Russia imported a whopping 328,000 miles during that same month. It was estimated that Russia acquired 37 million miles of fiber during the entirety of 2025, accounting for over 10% of the global production.What makes matters worse for Ukrainian defenders is that there is an estimated 111-million-mile shortfall in fiber optic cable supply across the world, adding to the various shortages that the data center industry has faced in recent years. Aside from the material shortfall, Ukraine faces trade barriers in acquiring more fiber. The BlueBird representative claimed that some Chinese companies have outright refused to sell Ukraine fiber optic cables.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: China is the primary supplier of this material, so it’s easier for Russia to obtain them through its massive land border with the country. While Ukraine could purchase fiber optic cables from suppliers located in other countries, that's not much of an alternative. The BlueBird rep notes: "there can be intermediaries in other countries, and prices can differ depending on the country and the purchasing route. But in the end, China remains the main source of the fiber optic material we are talking about.”There has also been talk of producing fiber optic cables domestically in Ukraine, but such manufacturing requires specially trained personnel who must practice on the already limited supply of fiber optic cables. Even if manufacturers automate production, they still require experienced personnel who can oversee the line and ensure the quality of the final product. You may like Ukrainian drones hit Russian data centers, disrupting Russian apps and services Russia bombs Ukrainian data centers in latest escalation Ukrainian drone attacks hammer Russia's finance ministry data center, damaged facility reportedly holds tax databases The data center build out has been causing all kinds of shortages. We’ve seen supply shortfalls in GPUs, memory chips, and even PCBs, but there’s also shortages in other seemingly unrelated industries like power infrastructure, optical transceivers, and even in critical skilled labor like electricians. This overwhelming demand has started affecting other industries not related to computing, like cars, home construction, and now, fiber optic attack drones. history.titleZh: 乌克兰无人机行动因AI数据中心建设潮引发光纤短缺而受限
history.descriptionZh:
2022年俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，无人机战争进入新阶段。俄军率先在前线使用带光纤系留的无人机来对抗电子战，如今乌俄双方都在使用这种“抗干扰”无人机。其核心原理是用物理光纤替代无线电链路，由地面站通过光纤线轴向无人机传输控制信号和视频回传，从而避免无线电信号被干扰、压制或侦测。相比传统无线电无人机，光纤无人机在强电子战环境下稳定性更高，但代价是需要消耗大量光纤线缆，且线缆供应、成本和后勤保障成为规模化生产的关键瓶颈。

在这一背景下，AI数据中心建设正在加剧乌克兰获取光纤线轴的难度。乌克兰国防无人机企业BlueBird Tech的研发代表在接受Ars Technica采访时称，过去几年光纤电缆价格上涨约6至10倍，原因是AI数据中心对光纤资源的需求不断吞噬供应。据采访估计，乌克兰和俄罗斯每月生产约5万架光纤无人机，每架无人机射程可达62英里（约100公里）。但供应链对比悬殊：2025年8月，乌克兰仅从中国供应商获得72英里光纤电缆，而俄罗斯同月进口高达32.8万英里；据估计，俄罗斯2025年全年获得约3700万英里光纤，占全球产量超过10%。

更不利的是，全球光纤电缆供应估计存在1.11亿英里缺口，这进一步加剧了数据中心行业近年遭遇的多类短缺。除材料不足外，乌克兰还面临贸易壁垒。BlueBird代表称，一些中国公司直接拒绝向乌克兰出售光纤电缆。中国是该材料的主要供应国，俄罗斯凭借与中国的漫长陆地边界更容易获得供应。乌克兰虽可从其他国家供应商采购，但替代方案有限。该代表表示，其他国家可能存在中间商，价格会因国家和采购路线不同而变化，“但归根结底，中国仍是我们所说的光纤材料的主要来源”。

乌克兰也在讨论本土生产光纤电缆，但制造需要经过专门培训的人员，而培训又必须在已经有限的光纤供应上练习。即使实现自动化生产，仍需要经验丰富的人员监督生产线并确保最终产品质量。文章还指出，数据中心建设潮已造成GPU、内存芯片、PCB，以及电力基础设施、光收发器甚至电工等关键熟练劳动力短缺。这种巨大需求正开始影响与计算无关的行业，如汽车、住宅建设，如今又波及光纤攻击无人机。对乌克兰而言，AI数据中心对光纤资源的争夺不仅推高价格，还通过全球供应短缺和采购壁垒削弱其继续扩大光纤无人机制造能力的前景。
